title: Kimi K3 Tech Blog: Terminal-Bench 2.1
methodologySummary: Moonshot AI reports Kimi K3 evaluated with Kimi Code at max reasoning effort, temperature = 1.0 and top-p = 1.0.
limitations: This selected numerical fact is developer reported. StackReplay did not reproduce the evaluation. Different or unreported setups do not establish a matched comparison.
